skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Radiant Serenity
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Radiant Serenity. Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.
skins.quote: Pain, rage, sorrow, joy... Logos silently sits at the peak of the spire, allowing the music to wash over him, allowing the emotions to envelop him. Finally, he picks up his pen, a composition rising from his heart.
